entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Major Memory Leak on Maccatalyst in .NET 9 & 10 Compared to .NET8 #34249
  • [Bug] [Android] System.ArgumentOutOfRangeException: Index was out of range. Must be non-negative and less than the size of the collection. Parameter name: index #34247

Closed

    .NET 10 SR5

    .NET 10 SR5
